# Generated by tools/Build-VereniaSpirit.py; modifier values come from source ideas.

HSM_VER_SP_add_HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service = {
 show_ideas_tooltip = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service
 hidden_effect = {
  if = {
   limit = { HSM_VER_SP_active = yes }
   set_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service
   remove_ideas = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
  else = { add_ideas = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service }
 }
}
HSM_VER_SP_remove_HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service = {
 effect_tooltip = { remove_ideas = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service }
 hidden_effect = {
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_idea = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service has_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service } }
   remove_ideas = HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service
   clr_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_HSM_ERI_DEV_reconstruction_service
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
 }
}

   limit = { HSM_VER_SP_active = yes }
   set_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_HSM_VER_FORCE_AVI_commission
   remove_ideas = HSM_VER_FORCE_AVI_commission
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
  else = { add_ideas = HSM_VER_FORCE_AVI_commission }
 }
}

   set_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_HSM_AVI_common_budget
   remove_ideas = HSM_AVI_common_budget
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
  else = { add_ideas = HSM_AVI_common_budget }
 }
}

  if = {
   limit = { HSM_VER_SP_active = yes }
   set_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_AVI_common_markets
   remove_ideas = AVI_common_markets
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
  else = { add_ideas = AVI_common_markets }
 }
}
HSM_VER_SP_remove_AVI_common_markets = {
 effect_tooltip = { remove_ideas = AVI_common_markets }
 hidden_effect = {
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_idea = AVI_common_markets has_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_AVI_common_markets } }
   remove_ideas = AVI_common_markets
   clr_country_flag = HSM_VER_SP_owned_AVI_common_markets
   HSM_VER_SP_refresh = yes
  }
 }
}

 if = { limit = { OR = { tag = ERI tag = EYR } }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_econcoop = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_econcoop = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_common_markets = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_common_markets = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_studentexchange = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_studentexchange = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_relaxd_citizenship = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_relaxd_citizenship = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_unified_intelligence_agency = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_unified_intelligence_agency = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_unified_intelligence_agency_lar = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_unified_intelligence_agency_lar = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_annual_military_exercises = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_annual_military_exercises = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_the_strong_arm_of_the_revolution = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_the_strong_arm_of_the_revolution = yes }
  if = { limit = { AVI = { HSM_VER_SP_has_AVI_Kriegsamt = yes } } HSM_VER_SP_add_AVI_Kriegsamt = yes }
